comment: Written from the maker's source at commit 7f2d7f2 (the plugin.json that carries 2.0.1); no source file changed between that commit and the repository head, so head was read. The sixteen ratio gate inputs are configured with the tooltip 'inverts button value', which the code does not do: process() line 194 turns a ratio on when the button rises while the jack is low, or when the jack rises while the button is low, and off again on the matching falling edge, so a gate has no effect at all while the button for that ratio is on. The README describes the same behaviour and a 1V threshold; the Schmitt trigger in the code uses 0.9V rising and 0.1V falling. The rate input's Schmitt trigger is left at Rack's defaults, so the clock threshold there is 1V rising and 0V falling. Two inputs are configured with an empty name and so have no tooltip at all: the rate input and the reset input. The phase offset knob and the reset button are also configured with empty names. Index order is not panel order in the output section: the trig column reads 0, 3, 8, 9, 6, 11 down the panel and the phase column 2, 4, 5, 10, 7, 12.
